description: Build the admin dashboard (design §12): ungated force-dynamic /admin/login, the (protected) route-group shell gated by requireAdminPage(), shared admin components (EntityTable/EntityForm/ImageField/OrderControls/DeleteButton), the Vercel Blob client-upload route guarded by requireAdmin(), full per-entity CRUD pages + server actions (singletons + lists + submissions triage) with Zod re-validation + revalidateTag + degraded no-creds mode, the optional secret-gated revalidate route, and the admin/action integration tests. Also write README.md and run the final zero-env gate. Depends on FEAT-001/002/003/004 (reuses auth guards + DAL + validation + shared ui/).
steps: Read context.json FIRST, then design.md §12 (admin & CRUD), §10 (Vercel Blob upload), §7 (revalidation), §9 (guards), §13 (validation), §14 (write error handling), §22 (tests), §25 (accepted FR-24.4 reading for README). All paths under datadive-web.

src/app/admin/login/page.tsx OUTSIDE the (protected) group, export const dynamic='force-dynamic', rendering Google sign-in / AccessDenied / 'sign-in not configured' (branches on hasAuthCreds() + ?error) so there is no redirect loop (F1) and cred-detection is request-time (N1).

src/app/admin/(protected)/layout.tsx: calls requireAdminPage() then renders the dashboard shell (nav to every entity + settings, signed-in identity, SignOut); export const dynamic='force-dynamic'. src/app/admin/(protected)/page.tsx: dashboard home with per-entity counts + quick links. When !hasAirtableCreds() show the read-only 'content backend not configured — saves disabled' banner (§12). src/components/admin/SignOut.tsx.

src/components/admin/*.tsx: EntityTable (order + visibility/published flags + edit/delete), EntityForm (client, react-hook-form + the entity Zod schema), ImageField (upload via @vercel/blob/client upload() -> /api/blob/upload, OR paste a Datadive Blob URL host-validated per §13, with a required alt input whenever a URL is present; when BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN absent, disable upload but still accept a pasted host-validated URL), OrderControls (up/down writing Order), DeleteButton (confirm dialog). Reuse the FEAT-004 ui/ primitives.

src/app/api/blob/upload/route.ts: handleUpload — onBeforeGenerateToken calls requireAdmin() and maps a thrown AuthError to a 401 Response; allowedContentTypes image/jpeg|png|webp|avif; maximumSizeInBytes 8MB; addRandomSuffix:true; SVG disallowed. onUploadCompleted server-log only.

Per-entity CRUD over the uniform pattern (§12/§20): singletons /admin/settings, /hero, /about, /cta (single edit form, save upserts the one row). Lists each with page.tsx (RSC reads getAll*) + new/page.tsx + [id]/page.tsx (reads getXById): /admin/nav, /services, /projects (inline ProjectImages gallery editor using the FEAT-002 ProjectImages writers), /industries, /stats, /clients, /reviews, /team, /blog (published/draft toggle). /admin/submissions read + status triage New/Read/Archived (no create). src/app/admin/actions/*.ts: every mutating action wrapped in withAdmin(), re-validates with Zod, writes via the DAL, calls revalidateTag(...) (settings also revalidates nav; blog/project also the per-item tag blogpost:{slug}/project:{slug}), redirects back with a success toast. When !hasAirtableCreds(), the action returns the typed 'content backend not configured' result and makes NO network call.
src/app/api/revalidate/route.ts (OPTIONAL, §7): POST { tag } behind a REVALIDATE_SECRET bearer header; returns 404/501 when the secret is unset. Not required for normal admin flow.

src/app/admin/actions/__tests__/*.test.ts (Vitest, mocked auth + fetch): unauthorized action rejected before any DAL call; valid create -> DAL write + revalidateTag called; invalid input -> field errors, no write; no-creds save -> typed 'not configured' result, no network.

README.md: setup; the full §5 Airtable schema contract mirroring schema.ts exactly; every §20 env var; deploy-to-Vercel (project root datadive-web/); and the ACCEPTED FR-24.4 reading VERBATIM — table names default in code with optional AIRTABLE_TABLE_* env overrides, only the Airtable base id + API key mandatory (§25/N3). Note the §23/NFR-14 Python/Auto-ETL seam as documentation only (not built).

FINAL ZERO-ENV GATE: from datadive-web with no env — npm install from the committed lockfile, npm run build, npm run lint, npx vitest run all pass; npm start serves / fully from seed. Fix any cross-feature seams. Remove temp/scratch files. Set FEAT-005 status to completed and record final results in findings. Commit locally inside datadive-web (never push).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` + `npm run lint` pass with ZERO env vars; `npx vitest run` passes all tests including the admin/action suite.
Unauthenticated /admin redirects to /admin/login; /admin/login shows the 'sign-in not configured' notice with zero env (no 500, no redirect loop).
With no Airtable creds, admin pages render from seed and any save returns the typed 'content backend not configured' result with no network call (degraded banner shown).
The Blob upload route rejects non-admins with 401, enforces type/size, and disallows SVG; ImageField still accepts a pasted host-validated Blob URL when the token is absent.
A valid admin create/update/delete writes via the DAL and triggers revalidateTag for the affected entity (settings also nav; blog/project also the per-item tag) — covered by integration tests.
README documents every env var, mirrors the §5 schema contract, and carries the accepted FR-24.4 reading verbatim; the final zero-env gate (build+lint+vitest+start) passes.
verification: cd datadive-web && npm run build && npm run lint  (zero env — must pass)
npx vitest run  (all tests incl. admin/action suite pass)
npm start then verify /admin -> /admin/login redirect and the no-creds 'not configured' notice + degraded admin render
